verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful

verses.arabicText: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ
verses.transliteration: Illā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū ṣ-ṣāliḥāti watawāṣaw bil-ḥaqi watawāṣaw bil-ṣabr
verses.translation: except those who have faith, do good, and urge each other to the truth, and urge each other to perseverance
